hook.text: Repeat a lie often enough and people believe it. That insight, attributed to Goebbels, underpins modern propaganda.

buildup.text: Key techniques include bandwagon appeal, fear-mongering, scapegoating, and appeal to authority.

discovery.text: Dehumanization turns enemies into insects or vermin in language.

twist.text: Modern propaganda uses data analytics to tailor messages to individuals. Mass manipulation is now precisely targeted.

climax.text: Propaganda techniques haven't changed. What changed is speed, scale, and personalization. Old tricks with new tools.

punchline.text: Same tricks, sharper delivery, bigger audience.

quiz.question: What makes modern propaganda more effective than historical versions?
options: People are less educated than before
Data analytics enable precisely targeted messaging
Modern propaganda only uses truthful information
